risks.title: Disponibilité et coûts des matières premières
risks.score_rationale: Raw materials represent PPG's single largest production cost component. Supply disruptions and price volatility directly impact profitability and operational efficiency. Citation: "Key assumptions used in the discounted cash flow model included projected future revenues, discount rates". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Fluctuations in raw material prices and supply availability, particularly titanium dioxide and petroleum-derived materials, significantly impact PPG's financial results and production costs.

risks.title: Risques macroéconomiques
risks.score_rationale: Global economic uncertainty, interest rate fluctuations, geopolitical tensions and trade policy changes directly affect demand for PPG products across multiple end-markets. Citation: "A weakening of the U.S. dollar by 10% against European currencies and by 20% against". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Macroeconomic headwinds including soft demand in Europe, automotive sector challenges, and industry project spending volatility impact PPG's top-line growth and profitability.

risks.title: Cybersécurité
risks.score_rationale: PPG's information systems and distributed manufacturing operations are vulnerable to cyber attacks that could disrupt operations, compromise data and damage reputation. Citation: "Key assumptions used in the discounted cash flow model included projected future revenues, discount rates". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Cybersecurity threats could impact operational continuity, data integrity and confidentiality across PPG's global facilities and supply chain systems.

risks.title: Conformité environnementale et réglementaire
risks.score_rationale: Increasing environmental regulations, particularly around emissions and waste management, require continuous investment in compliance and operational modifications. Citation: "Also, projections of any evaluation of effectiveness to future periods are subject to the risk". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Evolving environmental regulations, particularly related to greenhouse gas emissions and paint/coating disposal, increase operating costs and capital requirements.

risks.title: Competitive Pressures
risks.score_rationale: PPG operates in competitive coatings markets where price competition, product differentiation and market share gains are critical success factors. Citation: "Definition and Limitations of Internal Control over Financial Reporting A company s internal control over". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Intense competition from global and regional coatings manufacturers may limit pricing power, compress margins and challenge market share preservation.

risks.title: Risques géopolitiques et commerciaux
risks.score_rationale: PPG operates globally with significant exposure to tariffs, trade tensions, sanctions and geopolitical instability, particularly in Europe, China and Russia. Citation: "Consequences of material differences in the results compared with those anticipated in the forward-looking statements". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Trade policy uncertainty, tariffs, geopolitical tensions and regional conflicts impact supply chains, manufacturing costs and market access, particularly affecting emerging markets operations.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Volatility
risks.score_rationale: PPG's international revenues and costs are exposed to currency fluctuations that can impact reported earnings and competitiveness in local markets. Citation: "Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk PPG is exposed to market risks related to". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Fluctuations in currency exchange rates affect consolidated results, particularly impacting EMEA and Asia-Pacific regions where PPG has significant operations.

company_description: PPG Industries, Inc. manufactures and distributes paints, coatings, and specialty materials in the United States, Canada, the Asia Pacific, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through three segments: Global Architectural Coatings, Performance Coatings, and Industrial Coatings. The Global Architectural Coatings segment supplies a variety of decorative coatings, adhesives, sealants, and finishes, as well as paint strippers, stains, and related chemicals. Its Performance Coatings segment offers aerospace coatings, automotive refinishing coatings, protective and marine coatings, and traffic solutions comprising paints, thermoplastics, raised pavement markers, and other technologies for pavement marking. The Industrial Coatings segment provides automotive OEM coatings, industrial coatings, and packaging coatings, as well as specialty products, such as optical monomers and coatings, low-friction coatings, and other specialty products. risks_rationale_fr.0: Matières premières représentent le poste de coût le plus important de PPG. Disruptions et volatilité des prix impactent directement rentabilité et efficacité opérationnelle. Citation: "described in this section could adversely affect our results of operations, financial position and liquidity".
risks_rationale_fr.1: Incertitude économique mondiale, taux d'intérêt, tensions géopolitiques et politiques commerciales affectent directement la demande pour produits PPG sur multiples marchés finaux. Citation: "additional obstacles which may adversely affect our businesses and our results of operations, financial pos".
risks_rationale_fr.2: Systèmes d'information et opérations manufacturières distribuées de PPG vulnérables aux cyberattaques pouvant perturber opérations, compromettre données et nuire à la réputation. Citation: "also impact our revenues and our growth which could adversely affect our results of operations".
risks_rationale_fr.3: Régulations environnementales croissantes, en particulier émissions et déchets, exigent investissement continu en conformité et adaptations opérationnelles. Citation: "regulations, which could increase our compliance costs and could adversely affect our results of operations".
risks_rationale_fr.4: PPG opère sur marchés des peintures concurrentiels où concurrence par les prix, différenciation et gains de parts sont des facteurs clés de succès. Citation: "countries in which we operate could adversely affect our results and our effective tax rate".
risks_rationale_fr.5: PPG opère mondialement avec exposition significative aux tarifs, tensions commerciales, sanctions et instabilité, en particulier Europe, Chine et Russie. Citation: "our information technology systems could be compromised which could adversely affect our operations or reputation".
risks_rationale_fr.6: Revenus et coûts internationaux de PPG exposés aux fluctuations de change pouvant impacter résultats reportés et compétitivité sur les marchés locaux. Citation: "or production downtimes and operational disruptions, which could adversely affect our results of operations".

fr.positioning: Dans le sous‑secteur des produits chimiques spécialisés, PPG occupe une place de leader en tant que fournisseur intégré de revêtements pour l'architecture, l'industrie et l'aéronautique. Elle se situe en amont de la chaîne de valeur grâce à ses capacités de formulation et de production, et en aval grâce à son réseau de distribution directe aux détaillants et aux OEM.
